title: Keto Shrimp Ali Wrap
description: A flavorful keto wrap filled with succulent shrimp, crunchy vegetables, and creamy sauce, all wrapped in a low-carb tortilla.
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Season the shrimp with salt and pepper.
3. Grill the shrimp for 2-3 minutes per side, or until pink and cooked through.
4. Warm the Ali Wrap tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.

5. Assemble the wraps by spreading 1 tablespoon of Keto Ranch Dressing on each tortilla, followed by 3 grilled shrimp, 1/4 cup of sliced cucumber, 1/4 cup of sliced tomato, and 1/4 cup of thinly sliced red onion.
6. Top each wrap with chopped cilantro and a sprinkle of Electric Fries Seasoning.
